evals.prompt: How do I run Lighthouse from CI on a staged build?
evals.expected_output: Recommends the CI integration path (lighthouse-ci, GitHub Action, CircleCI Orb) with the right CLI flags.

evals.prompt: What CLI flag do I pass to Lighthouse to only run the performance and accessibility categories?
evals.expected_output: Recommends --only-categories=performance,accessibility and points at the CLI options anchor.

evals.prompt: Why does my Lighthouse performance score change between runs?
evals.expected_output: Points at docs/variability.md and the FAQ entry on score variance.
expectations: Maps to the FAQ + Docs & Recipes category

evals.prompt: How do I run Lighthouse against a desktop form factor?
How do I author a custom Lighthouse audit?
evals.expected_output: Surfaces docs/new-audits.md, docs/recipes/custom-audit, and docs/plugins.md as a chain.
expectations: Surfaces docs/plugins.md together (a chain, not alternatives)

evals.prompt: Recommend a Lighthouse plugin for real-user CrUX metrics.
Which third-party service uses Lighthouse for monitoring?
evals.expected_output: Recommends 1-3 services (Calibre, DebugBear, Treo, etc.) from the Integrations list.
expectations: Maps to the third-party Integrations category

evals.prompt: How do I view a Lighthouse report as HTML and share it as a gist?
evals.expected_output: Points at the Viewing a report section (HTML/JSON/CSV, Viewer, GitHub Gist sharing).
expectations: Maps to Using Lighthouse / Viewing a report
Mentions the online Viewer and gist sharing

evals.prompt: How do I configure Lighthouse with a custom config JSON?
What's the difference between --throttling-method=devtools and simulate?
evals.expected_output: Explains the throttling methods and cites docs/throttling.md.
expectations: Explains devtools vs provided vs simulate
